articles.title: HISTORIC STRETCH! 🤩 Caitlin Clark & Kelsey Mitchell duo sets new league record | WNBA on ESPN
articles.summary: See highlights as Caitlin Clark (24 PTS, 3 REB & 7 AST on 4 3PM) and Kelsey Mitchell (29 PTS, 3 REB, 2 AST & 1 BLK on 4 3PM) lead the Indiana Fever past the Toronto Tempo, 101-95.
body: Clark records 20+ PTS and 5+ AST for the 6th straight game, tying her own WNBA record, while she and Mitchell each reach 20+ points for the 16th time this season, setting a new WNBA record for a duo. (Diana Taurasi & Cappie Pondexter had 15 in 2008).
